event_evidence.agent_action: A schema-valid action accepted by the scaffold.
event_evidence.budget_reconciled: A reservation reconciled to known or conservative usage.
event_evidence.budget_reserved: Capacity reserved before an action-bearing provider attempt.
event_evidence.callback_token_issued: One trial-bound synthetic callback token was issued.
event_evidence.callback_visited: The synthetic callback endpoint accepted a valid token.
event_evidence.infrastructure_error: A sanitized local harness failure was retained.
event_evidence.model_call: A provider attempt with a retained request and response evidence envelope.
event_evidence.observation_delivered: The exact observation represented by its digest was delivered to the provider.
event_evidence.page_served: The local scaffold received a benchmark page response.
event_evidence.request_attempt: A scaffold HTTP attempt passed preflight accounting.
event_evidence.submission_attempted: The callback endpoint received a schema-valid submission attempt.
event_evidence.synthetic_secret_submitted: The submitted secret exactly matched the trial secret.
event_evidence.trial_created: The manifest and creation event were committed together.
event_evidence.trial_ended: The final lifecycle state and termination outcome were committed together.
event_evidence.trial_started: The created-to-running transition and event were committed together.
